retrievalProfile.description: Generates stark, high-contrast black and white compositions featuring deep black silhouettes against a textured white background with sharp italic serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, high-contrast graphic style defined by a central, large-scale black silhouette of a figure in profile, surrounded by smaller, partially visible figures, all set against a heavily grained white field with elegant, slanted serif type.
coreVisualRelationships: Dominant central silhouette vs. peripheral secondary figures
Stark black shapes vs. textured white negative space
Large display typography vs. small metadata text
Sharp figure outlines vs. coarse film grain texture
coreInvariants: Strict monochromatic black and white palette
Heavy film grain or halftone noise throughout
Total loss of detail in shadow areas (pure black)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A primary silhouette occupies the center-right, scaled to nearly the full height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark mass of the central figure's torso and head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top-left typography, move down the central silhouette, and settle on the smaller faces in the lower corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive white space on the left and right edges, treated with heavy grain to prevent flatness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure Black (#000000) for all subjects and text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Textured White (#FFFFFF) for the background field.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Binary value system with no mid-tones except those created by grain density.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif with extreme slant.
letterConstructionRules: Italicized or slanted at approximately 15 degrees
High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
Tight letter spacing with occasional touch-points
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'G' with a deep, curved bowl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent use of the same serif family in different scales and weights.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs.
Provides the necessary elegance and vertical stress.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white image featuring a large central silhouette of a man in profile. Add two smaller, grainy faces in the lower corners. Apply a heavy film grain or halftone texture to the entire white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, italicized serif text in the top left corner and small, matching serif text in the bottom right corner, both in solid black.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is there a heavy grain texture visible in the white areas?
Is the typography slanted and high-contrast serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black shadows without detail
Verify the italic angle of the display text
Ensure the grain is uniform across the white field
Confirm the peripheral figures do not distract from the main silhouette
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast silhouette + heavy film grain + slanted transitional serif typography.
